schema.description: Response schema for a single appointment created via a public interface.

rescheduling.disabled_message: Rescheduling is not available within 24 hours of your appointment

data.description: A public appointment represents a booking that a client has made with a provider for a service.

rescheduling.disabled_message: Rescheduling is not available within 24 hours of your appointment

add_to_calendar_url.description: Canonical URL for adding the appointment to a calendar. Resolves to the account's active custom domain when configured, otherwise the canonical app host. The host portion may change if the account changes its custom-domain configuration.

cancel_url.description: Canonical URL for canceling the appointment. Resolves to the account's active custom domain when configured, otherwise the canonical app host. The host portion may change if the account changes its custom-domain configuration.

cancellation.description: Information about whether the appointment can be canceled by the client.

allowed.description: Whether the appointment can be canceled by the client.

disabled_message.description: A message explaining why cancellation is disabled, if applicable. Only present when allowed is false.

confirmed_at.description: Time at which the object was confirmed.

end_at.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

local.description: The local date/time in ISO-8601 format, including the UTC offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00`).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the local time (IANA format).

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).

utc.description: The UTC date/time in ISO-8601 format (with time zone information).

end_at.title: ZonedDateTime

ics_url.description: Canonical URL for downloading an ICS file for the appointment. Resolves to the account's active custom domain when configured, otherwise the canonical app host. The host portion may change if the account changes its custom-domain configuration.

reschedule_url.description: Canonical URL for rescheduling the appointment. Resolves to the account's active custom domain when configured, otherwise the canonical app host. The host portion may change if the account changes its custom-domain configuration.

rescheduling.description: Information about whether the appointment can be rescheduled by the client.

allowed.description: Whether the appointment can be rescheduled by the client.

disabled_message.description: A message explaining why rescheduling is disabled, if applicable. Only present when allowed is false.

start_at.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

local.description: The local date/time in ISO-8601 format, including the UTC offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00`).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the local time (IANA format).

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).

utc.description: The UTC date/time in ISO-8601 format (with time zone information).

start_at.title: ZonedDateTime

urls.description: Deprecated nested URL collections for this public appointment. Use the flat *_url fields instead.
